original_intent: Evolve Kaite toward first-class, opinionated AI/ML execution capabilities for self-hosted Buildkite agents while preserving direct use and downstream derivation.
derived_intent: Make the existing requirement layers and hardware contracts explicit as a small capability set, bind image identity to runtime validation, advertise truthful Buildkite tags, and update active docs/CI/release surfaces without adding a matrix dimension.
active_boundaries: Do not modify protected main; preserve Docker/Buildkite/Release Please interfaces unless the new contract requires additive evolution; do not enable inactive accelerator hosts.
repo_scope: Dockerfile, docker-bake.hcl, cmd/kaite, requirements docs, deploy examples, GitHub image/release workflows, README/docs, tests, and required governance artifacts
